verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron provides Postgres-native scheduling with cron syntax for recurring jobs, capable of running SQL, DB functions, or invoking Edge Functions/HTTP endpoints, and Supabase Queues complements this with durable message-driven workflows; both are agent-accessible via MCP/CLI/API, fitting AI-native automation use cases. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community corroboration of Cron/Queues specifically in production use (only first-party docs cited).
